refNotes: All 106 referenced families run coverage=exhaustive (every released typed question); all checked questions ok: 0 mismatch, 0 form, 0 incomplete, 0 ambiguous, 0 refError.

Every reference parses the question STATEMENT (regex over the exported prompt/figure) and computes with exact Fractions/integers/SymPy; the stored answer is only compared, never used to derive the expected text. Production code and generator solving code were not read or imported.

Runner mcBad is a false alarm for ajrat, ajrstd, avfas, avlow: their distractor options are value-equal to the key but NOT in the required form (lowest terms / standard form / mixed number). Verified separately by script: exactly one option is both value-equal and in the required form and it is the keyed one (ajrat 450/450, ajrstd 400/400, avfas 420/420, avlow 360/360). Not an error.

Choice-typed (A-D) families: export.ts does not export options for typed choice items (no mc field, none in the prompt), so a letter cannot be mapped to an option for 15 families (see unsupported.json). Exception: ajcrcmp and akscmp and amclass list the four candidates in the prompt; the letters are assumed to follow the listed order A..D (every one of 400/400, 400/400, 298/298 stored keys is consistent with that assumption, so it is almost certainly right, but it is an assumption).

amclass: items such as 0.121212... and 0.333... are read as recurring decimals (rational); 0.1010010001... (one more 0 each time) as irrational; natural numbers are 1,2,3,... (0 is a whole number but not natural), consistent with the whole-number-not-natural template.

aiest and avpest: rounding is half-up; no released question has an operand exactly at a half, so the convention is not exercised. aifword: whole-glass/bag questions have integral quotients in all 400 cases (no floor ambiguity).

ascloc: verified by Verdict (substitution): five rational-parameter points of the stored circle satisfy the locus equation exactly (SymPy), k=1 (a line) never occurs; three points determine the circle. asroot: roots via numeric nroots of z^n - w (30 digits), arguments rounded to exact rationals and count n checked.

Figures: aiint/aitemp number-line marks agree with the statement operands (checked by script, 500/500 and 500/500); avarea (grid rows/cols/shaded cells), avlat (every lattice box and digit), avpp (place-value split headers) are checked against the statement inside the reference (Verdict False on disagreement) - none disagreed. cnt: the dots figure count equals the stored answer for 120/120. Other figures were not rendered.

Word forms: wordBad=0 everywhere (typed and word answers identical). Wording of word forms checked only by reading one random sample for 10 families (ajci ajsi ajrdiv avmarked ajplamt ajwork ajgrow aimulti ajpl avfwq): all consistent with the typed question; wording of the remaining word forms is NOT verified.
Minor wording note (not an answer error, not registered): aimulti lift template reads "goes up 1 floors" for a count of 1.
